probes.sampling: capped equally per available size; positive edges only
probes.caveat: Real-data probes can exploit composition correlated with size; replication is the controlled check.

replication.scope: Synthetic multiset intervention on frozen node representations; not task accuracy or causal social effects.

size_intervention.scope: Only decoder size input/scaling is clamped; members, attention, and encoder are frozen. This diagnoses computational dependence, not an intervention on real interaction size.
